units.source_text: 古歌：“众手都来拉纸币，我虽思取恐徒劳。”

en.t: An old poem says: Everyone reaches out to pull the paper streamers; though I want to take one, I fear it would be in vain.
It appears in the Kokin Wakashu.

units.source_text: 祓禊毕，大家拉过纸币来拂身，然后将纸币抛入河中。

en.t: After the purification rite was finished, everyone drew the paper streamers over themselves to cleanse their bodies, and then threw them into the river.

units.source_text: 此处比喻爱薰君的女子甚多。

en.t: Here this is a metaphor for the great number of women who love Lord Kaoru.
